title: Napoleon’s Triumph · full board
description: Full-board draft extraction with source coordinates, independent elements and provisional locale/approach associations. Reviewed pilot symbols are retained. No gameplay integration.

numbered_reference_source.note: Native embedded image; used for locale IDs, not yet registered as a source overlay.

coverage.symbols: Full-board candidate pass across established symbol families. Source crops and provisional associations are available for inspection.
coverage.geometry: Road ink and pale approach bars traced across the board. Locale footprints use source-barrier faces; missing closures are inferred from reference anchors. Frontage remains unreviewed outside the pilot.
coverage.remaining: Full-board visual review and missed/false-positive marks; IDs 145 and 146 not located in the numbered reference; incomplete road ink at printed interruptions; inferred locale boundaries, sided penalty associations and approach frontage. Landscape is not extracted.

registration.method: Independent x/y scale between full reference and board dimensions; same framing verified visually at the map edges.
registration.notes: Centers are draft manual/OCR label centers, generally within about 10 reference pixels. Null means the number could not be confidently located or separated from adjacent/control-track numerals; do not treat as an absent locale.
